_comment_pipeline: Eva v3 (the authors' spatial-token-map / full-tile approach, see eva/project/notebooks/Eva-pipeline-v3.ipynb): overlapping tile_size x tile_size tiles cover the whole image, producing one HxWx768 token map; a cell's feature is the mean token vector over its own segmentation-mask pixels. 'supervised' trains a logistic-regression classifier head on these frozen embeddings (the main benchmark number); 'leiden' instead clusters them unsupervised and scores clusters against ground truth via greedy majority-label F1. Both modes share the same extraction step -- run 'extract' once, then 'supervised'/'leiden' reuse the cached embeddings.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_folds_dir: fold_indices.json's own 'train'/'test' integer lists are NOT consistent row positions into the master quantification CSV (verified: they overlap between train and test, and don't span the full row range) -- they come from create_validation_set_from_fold()'s per-fold-file reset index. The per-fold fold_{i}_train.csv/fold_{i}_test.csv files are read directly instead; they carry sample_id+cell_id and are mutually disjoint (verified: 0 overlap, sizes sum to the full dataset). NOT YET CONFIRMED by Lukas/Aroj: each fold's *_train.csv is much smaller than its *_test.csv (e.g. fold_1: train=53535, test=150750) -- the reverse of IMMUcan's folds.json (80/20 train/test). Taken at face value here; please double check these files weren't saved train/test-swapped at creation time before trusting cHL numbers.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_exclude_markers: Histone H3/dsDNA/anti-H2AX (pS139)/pSLP-76/SLP-76 have no match in Eva's marker_to_gene dict (eva/project/utils/constant.py, 213 entries) under any plausible spelling, and Eva's embedding layer does a plain dict lookup with no fallback (hard KeyError on an unmatched name). Same for CD161/CD153 (CD30L)/CD28/IL-10. Eva sees 37 of the 45 channels.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_marker_name_map: Checked against eva/project/utils/constant.py's marker_to_gene dict (Eva's naming differs from ours, e.g. 'RORgammaT' not 'RORgT', 'PDL1' not 'PD-L1') -- every entry below resolves to a real key.
